description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to improve access in the delivery of selected public services in Assam.

The development objective of the Assam Citizen-Centric Service Delivery Project for India is to improve access in the delivery of selected public services in Assam. The project comprises of two components. The first component, technical assistance will provide specialized technical assistance to support implementation of the government program and the achievement of the project development objective (PDO). It consists of following sub-components: (i) strengthening right to public services (RTPS) implementation; (ii) supporting process re-engineering in selected services; (iii) setting up public facilitation centers; and (iv) promoting citizen engagement. The second component, results-based financing aims to support the Government of Assam to implement critical public management reforms related to delivery of public services.

Each audit of the Financial Statements shall coverthe period of one fiscal year of the Borrower, commencing with the fiscal year in which the first withdrawal was made under thePreparation Advance for the Project. | Frequency :CONTINUOUS

Finance Agreement :Financial Management (2/3) | Description :The audited Financial Statements for each such period shall befurnished to the Bank. in respect of Part 1 of the Project | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :Financial Management (3/3) | Description :The audited Financial Statements for each such period shall befurnished to the Bank in respect of Part 2 of the Project. | Frequency :Yearly

title.narrative: Improved processes for targeted services in Government departments

target.value: Cumulatively process improvement implemented for 124 services

actual.value: Business process reengineering that involves a combination of administrative streamlining/ simplification, elimination of redundantsteps, and end-to-end digitalisation have been completed for 146 services.

title.narrative: Access to RTPS Services expanded to Targeted districts

target.value: Notification of total 90 RTPS services in the targeted districts

actual.value: The Sixth Schedule Autonomous Councils notified a total of 119 services under the RTPS.

title.narrative: Operational Facilitation Centers comprising PFCs and Common Service Centers (CSCs) to serve as points of access for RTPS Services (Text, Custom, PBC)

baseline.value: 30 fully operational Public Facilitation Centers identified.

target.value: (i) Cumulative 280 PFCs fullyoperational; (ii) Cumulative 1500 CSCs accredited to deliver RTPS services

actual.value: Total 362 PFCs were made operational and 1,500 CSCs accredited as RTPS access points. PFCs and CSCs enabled submission of more than1.50 million applications for services.

title.narrative: Number of applications submitted on-line for RTPS services. (Text, Custom, PBC)

actual.value: More than 7.570 million applications for RTPS services were submitted online. Of these 6.80 million applications for services were received on ARTPS Portal.

title.narrative: Number of Services notified under RTPS Act

baseline.value: 55 RTPS services notified under the Act.

actual.value: Cumulatively 310 services have been notified under Assam RTPS Act.

title.narrative: Number of applications for RTPS with women as beneficiaries

baseline.value: Applications for RTPS with women as beneficiaries at 20%.

target.value: 42.5% of total applications for RTPS with women as beneficiaries.

actual.value: More than 2 million women have drawn benefits of RTPS services. This translates into 28% women service recipients vis-à-vis total cohort of service applicant.

baseline.value: Detailed project report and implementation plan to be approved by GoA.

target.value: Stabilization of RTPS portal, with RTPS MIS and performance monitoring mechanism in place

actual.value: The multilingual ARTPS Portal serves as gateway for online access of 310 RTPS services.

title.narrative: Compliant ARTPS applications related to 10 most availed services delivered within timeframe prescribed by ARTPS Act

baseline.value: For 10 most availed services, 35% compliant ARTPS applications delivered within timeframe prescribed by ARTPS Act

target.value: For 10 most availed RTPS services, compliance with notified service delivery timelines is ensured for at least 60 percent of onlineservice applications.

actual.value: Compliance with notified service delivery timelines was ensured for 70 percent of the applications for 10 most availed RTPS services.

title.narrative: Increase in RTPS beneficiary feedback on service delivery

target.value: Citizens' Feedback on RTPS delivery collected, analyzed and published.

actual.value: Beneficiary feedback mechanism operationalized and recorded 95% satisfaction level. Citizen Satisfaction on accessing service is tracked on the portal; and records 4.2 out of 5.

title.narrative: ARTPS Policy framework and institutional mechanism strengthened

baseline.value: ARTPS Act 2012 enacted and ARTPS Rules 2012 framed

target.value: Grievance Redress mechanism for the ARTPS is operational online

actual.value: Appeal Management System and Grievances Redressal Mechanism are operational online; and have and has resolved more than 39,000 grievances and 1,100 RTPS Appeals.

title.narrative: Number of Online Services available at the ARTPS Portal

target.value: Cumulatively 95 services made available on RTPS portal.

actual.value: ARTPS Portal provides citizens access to 310 RTPS services at project completion date. More services have been onboarded to the Portal even after the project period.
